+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: A second held URL flow under the same wire id sends an accept for the earlier flow with no completion
+---
+Found during ^etqn9dn.
+
+In MCPServer+Elicitation.swift, `awaitHostCompletion(of:)` holds the URL-mode accept of the host handler. When a second flow opens under a wire id that is still held, the function resumes the earlier continuation with `nil`. `nil` means "the flow completed", thus the earlier flow sends ACCEPT to the server, but its completion never came.
+
+Decide the correct answer for the earlier flow. A possible answer: a cancel with a reason in `_meta` (for example "a newer URL flow used the same elicitation id"), through the same `wireResult(of:)` path as `connectionEndedReason`.
+
+Start with a fixed-order test that fails on the current code: two URL flows of the handler under one wire id, and the test reads the result of the first flow on the wire. No time limit, sleep, poll or retry. #elicitation-fixes
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m53weh5emm9hyyq21e75gy61
+  text: |-
+    Research and work done.
+
+    Cause: `awaitHostCompletion(of:)` in MCPServer+Elicitation.swift resumed the earlier held continuation with `nil`. `nil` means "the flow completed", thus `resolve` returned the accept of the handler for the earlier flow.
+
+    Fix: the earlier continuation now resumes with `.cancel(reason: replacedByNewerFlowReason)` ("a newer URL flow used the same elicitation id"). The cancel goes through `wireResult(of:)` the same as `connectionEndedReason`, so the reason is in `_meta.reason` (R4). A new warning record `mcpElicitationHeldFlowReplaced` (MultitoolTelemetry.LogMessage) holds the wire id. I updated the file header, the doc of the function, README.md and docs/SECURITY.md.
+
+    Check of the same cause in the file: `complete(elicitationId:generation:)` is the only other path that resumes a held flow with `nil`, and it does so only on a real completion. `endHeldHostElicitations()` resumes with a cancel. No other path sends a false accept.
+
+    Discovery: `openContextElicitation` adds no entry for a second context URL question under a wire id in use. That question can wait until the host session ends it (no wire completion and no connection end reaches it). It is not a false accept. I recorded it as new task ^e7vbxzd.
+
+    Test: `aSecondFlowUnderAHeldWireIdCancelsTheEarlierFlow` in MCPElicitationTests.swift. Fixed order. The gate wait ends on the end of the first flow or on the end of the second flow, thus it always ends. The catch path disconnects, so each held flow ends before the throw. The server has no connection, the same as the disconnect and new-connect tests, thus `withConnection(of:_:)` does not apply.
+
+    Note: each build writes the SwiftPM warning "missing creator for mutated node" for the mlx-swift_Cmlx bundle. The RED build wrote it before my change too. It is not from the code of this repo.
